The per-image values of every pair, or of one pair, as a data frame

Source: R/spicy.R
bind.Rd

Returns, for each image, its condition and the value of each pair that spicy() tested: for the cell method its effect (by default the extra fraction of to cells with a from cell within r; with effect = "count", the extra from cells per to cell), or the L-function summary for the image method. Use it for your own plots or models, or with from and to to look up the images behind one pair.

Usage

bind(results, pairName = NULL, from = NULL, to = NULL, parent = NULL)

Arguments

results

The SpicyResults object returned by spicy().

pairName

A pair, as "from__to". If NULL, all pairs are returned.

from, to

One pair: a table of that pair alone, with its value in a column effect (value for the image method) and, for the cell method, each image's weight in the test.

parent

For a Kontextual result, the parent population of the pair given by from and to.

Value

A data.frame with one row per image, named by image: imageID, condition, subject (if given) and one column per pair, named "from__to", or with from and to the columns effect (or value) and weight. NA where the pair could not be measured in an image.

Examples


data(spicyTest)
df <- bind(spicyTest)

data("diabetesData")
res <- spicy(diabetesData, condition = "stage", subject = "case", r = 50, from = "Tc", to = "Th")
head(bind(res, from = "Tc", to = "Th"))
#>     imageID condition subject     effect weight
#> A09     A09     Onset    6362 -0.4514128     NA
#> A11     A11     Onset    6362 -0.4166667     NA
#> A16     A16     Onset    6362  1.0000000     NA
#> A17     A17     Onset    6362  0.2318507     NA
#> A25     A25     Onset    6362  0.1641414     NA
#> A39     A39     Onset    6362         NA     NA
